I've completed the full search pass and submitted one plan per rule. Summary of what the workers will find:

**Likely deviations to focus on:**
- **LD / T4C** — §13.5 (p0208) expressly labels the Termination for Convenience Fee and Termination for Cause Fee as liquidated damages, sized as a percentage of Estimated Remaining Value (p0187, p0189), with a one-year notice requirement. I flagged the coordination point so the same fee isn't redlined twice.
- **IP** — §10.4 Developed Software (p0185) gives M&I ownership of work Customer pays for, with only a partial refund/credit. Customer Data ownership (p0243) is favourable and should not be flagged.
- **INDEMN** — both directions exist (p0219 Customer-side, p0220 M&I-side); the risk is breadth of the Customer indemnity and whether M&I's covers third-party IP.
- **LOL-CAP** — §13.4 cap (p0207) plus the ACH-specific narrowing at p0117.
- **ASSIGN** — §22.4 (p0289) bars assignment by operation of law with a merger carve-out; read with §11.3 and p0284 for M&I exit/reprice rights on our change of control.

**Rules with no burden on us (no redline expected):** MFN and NONCOMPETE returned nothing across two search rounds; AUDIT provisions run in our favour (p0276, p0277) rather than against our usage.

**Present and likely compliant or near-compliant:** INSURANCE (§14.1, limits may be redacted), TRANSITION (§11.4 is strong though at our expense — data-return gap noted), RENEWAL (§2.2 proposal mechanic), NOSOLICIT (§22.14, mutual), GOVLAW (Wisconsin courts — outside the accepted list but a rationale note, not a deviation, in a Wisconsin-Wisconsin deal).

**Needs substantive reading before classification:** EXCLUSIVITY (no express sole-supplier language, but §3 appointment, §21.10 and §21.11 may operate as de facto all-requirements), MINCOMMIT (Monthly Base Fee take-or-pay), WARRANTY (§16.1 warranties versus the all-caps disclaimer at p0236, read with the §9 Performance Standards), and LICENSE (§23.2 term-limited source-code grant — affiliate/contractor coverage to verify).
